title: Red Tulip
body:
"Red tulips are classic flowers that simbolize love and passion."

Description


The Red Tulip are sellable common flowers, that can be found around in the Finlay and Flowering Meadows regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 25$ per tulip. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.92% per flower.
